name: vatsingranite-erp
description: Vatsin Granite Quarry Management & ERP Platform — Multi-Quarry Operations System

scripts.build: echo 'Web is pre-built; no server-side build step needed'
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @vatsingranite/shared && npm run build -w @vatsingranite/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @vatsingranite/shared && npm run build -w @vatsingranite/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vatsingranite/api && npm run test -w @vatsingranite/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @vatsingranite/api && npm run lint -w @vatsingranite/web
